content: {"summary":"Customers report persistent Wi‑Fi and Bluetooth auto‑connect problems, with many noting that toggling Wi‑Fi from the control center fails to fully disable it, leaving the device searching for networks [#tk_2185386]. Several users complain that Bluetooth remains active after being turned off in the quick‑settings panel, causing battery drain and unwanted headphone connections [#tk_2322511] [#tk_2618306]. Audio sync issues across iOS 10 and 11 on multiple carriers and devices further frustrate users, who suspect software rather than network causes [#tk_2652619]. Additionally, personal hotspot and airplane mode settings do not revert to previous states, leading to confusion and repeated network resets [#tk_2627809] [#tk_2449499]."}
